build_detection_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with configurable sampler, mapper, and batch size from a Detectron2 config
build_detection_test_loader: build a detection test data loader with inference sampler and trivial batch collator for evaluation
get_detection_dataset_dicts: get merged detection dataset dictionaries from multiple registered dataset names with optional empty annotation filtering
repeat_factors_from_category_frequency: compute per-image repeat factors based on category frequency to oversample rare categories during training
train_loader_from_config: construct training loader arguments from a Detectron2 config including dataset balancing and sampler selection
